sub_scenario.family: rehearsal load versus protected voice clarity
sub_scenario.one_line: software developer advocate: choose async repository review and one short question session

dialogue.content: I spent the first hour tidying the demo repository and closing stale entries.
Anything still open?
Two items, both with owners.
The launch calendar review wrapped early today.
Any surprises in it?
None worth recording.
I can record a concise feature update for a community channel.
That is a single take with breaks.
It is not four hours of live troubleshooting.
Someone new shadowed me in the developer studio this morning.
Did that slow you down?
A little, but the questions were good ones.
I batched my replies about the release weeks into one message before lunch.
Cleaner than drip-feeding answers.
Much cleaner.
On 8 August, I used the annotated commands to run one product-demo rehearsal before a Friday livestream.
How did the livestream sound?
My explanations stayed crisp, even through the debugging section.
I prepare demos with a runnable repository and annotated command notes.
Can attendees test those without another rehearsal?
Yes, they can leave comments on the walkthrough.
I archived last cycle's notes on the launch calendar and set up the new folder.
A fresh start?
As fresh as these things get.
You hosted a panel last month.
I shared the speaking time and it was not before a release-day livestream.
That made the load lower.
A vendor call about the demo repository ran long but ended well.
Worth the time?
This one, yes.
I walked through the developer studio checklist with the new starter.
How did they do?
Careful and quick, a good sign.
Quiet afternoon; I cleared the backlog around the release weeks.
A rare day.
I did not waste it.
I flagged a small inconsistency in the launch calendar records and fixed it at the source.
Root cause or symptom?
Root cause, for once.
On 17 October, I joined two late troubleshooting rehearsals before an 08:00 release livestream.
What happened on stream?
My voice gave out during the API migration explanation, so the engineer finished it.
I sketched next week's plan for the release weeks before leaving.
Ahead of schedule?
Ahead enough to sleep well.
Lunch walk, then a clean pass through the demo repository updates.
Does the walk help?
It resets the afternoon.
I have been managing acid reflux with an earlier bedtime and reduced late speaking; it flares after long evening sessions.
Can the repository carry some preparation work?
Yes, that is why I maintain it carefully.
The product VP says both rehearsals would make the livestream feel more polished to analysts.
Does polish change the release time?
No, the release and livestream begin at 08:00.
I closed the week by updating the developer studio handover notes.
Anything unusual to hand over?
Blessedly little.
How should I rank an annotated-repository review against two Thursday night troubleshooting rehearsals before the Friday 08:00 livestream?
